scientific_question: Do alpha-specific held-endpoint conservative equilibria exist inside the exact registered nonpenetration domain once normal contact reactions are admitted?

model_selection.selected_now: frictionless rigid unilateral normal contact for static feasibility only

not_selected_now.terminate_at_no_contact_boundary: premature before a parameter-free static contact feasibility test
not_selected_now.compliant_contact: would introduce uncalibrated normal stiffness, damping and possibly friction
not_selected_now.dynamic_hard_contact: closed until the static KKT gate passes on a target alpha

geometry_contract.partial_same_branch_pairs: exact fixed rest-material separation half-space clipped from the unit square
geometry_contract.junction_socket_pairs: must be expanded from the formal registered active subsegments without changing the socket crop
geometry_contract.required_center_distance: must retain the formal diameters and minimum_clearance exactly
geometry_contract.degenerate_or_nonunique_witness: fail closed; no arbitrary normal or multiplier is accepted

candidate_default_thresholds.note: Defaults are unit-test and prototype values. A physical alpha run must pre-freeze scale-aware thresholds before observing its result.

hard_static_acceptance_gate: Every individual registered gap is finite and satisfies the frozen primal tolerance.
Every normal multiplier is finite and nonnegative within the frozen force tolerance.
The dimensional stationarity residual satisfies the same force-balance standard as preparation.
The complementarity product is below its frozen N*m tolerance.
Every active contact has a unique differentiable closest-point witness, or a separately specified nonsmooth method is used.
A second-order stability audit is performed; the included nullspace PSD helper is only a sufficient check, not a complete weak-active critical-cone theorem.
The exact formal guard registration, contact domains, diameters and minimum clearance are preserved.

required_before_opening: at least one target alpha passes the static KKT and stability gates
a pre-frozen time-stepping complementarity or impulse law
nonpenetration and impulse complementarity certificates at every accepted step
momentum and energy accounting that separates physical impact loss from numerical drift
an explicit friction and restitution policy; neither is silently inferred

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not constrain only min_i g_i; it hides contact identity and produces a nonsmooth scalar.
Do not add a static nonpenetration constraint and then release into the unchanged no-contact ODE.
Do not relax the formal same-branch material exclusion or junction socket crop to manufacture feasibility.
Do not call penalty stiffness a first-principles prediction without calibration or an independently justified asymptotic limit.
Do not promote this candidate module into 02_模拟程序 without explicit user authorization.
